basis: Cell wall invertase 2 of the BETL; mn1 mutant has miniature seeds and BETL defects (Cheng et al. 1996 Plant Cell); BETL 9.9x over next compartment in Visium (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun SD1); LCM agreement (Fu Table S6). Not DE in the 6-7 DAP Yuan 2024 scRNA.

MYB-related master activator of BETL genes, BETL-specific (Gomez et al. 2002 Plant Cell); in situ and DE c2 only, pct 0.45 vs 0.02 (Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun); BETL 6x over PC in Visium but low counts (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun SD1).

Imprinted cysteine-rich peptide required for BETL differentiation and nutrient allocation (Costa et al. 2012 Curr Biol); DE c2/c9 0.59 vs 0.07 (Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun); BETL 14x over PC in Visium (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun SD1).

MYB-related TF; mybr29 mutant BETL has fewer wall ingrowths; DE outer BETL c2 0.77 vs 0.04 (Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun Fig 7); BETL 9x over PC in Visium (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun SD1). NCBI describes LOC103647818 as KUA1-like.

Sucrose/H+ symporter; BETL9-promoter RNAi of SUT1/SUT7 reduced wall ingrowths and kernel weight; BETL 3.4x, some PC (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun Fig 4). Also companion cells of leaf phloem (sorghum_leaf.tsv SUT1 row) and DE in Yuan 2024 aleurone c4 (0.31 vs 0.15): not BETL-exclusive.
SUT1-like sucrose transporter co-targeted by the BETL RNAi (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun Fig 4); BETL 8.1x in Visium; low counts. Single study.
Small cysteine-rich BETL protein; in situ BETL (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun Fig 2u; BETL gene family Hueros et al. 1995/1999); BETL 10.9x in Visium. Not in Yuan 2024 DE.

BETL-specific LTP-like protein regulated by MRP1; in situ BETL (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun Table S3; Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun) and DE c2/c9 0.70 vs 0.07; BETL 12.2x in Visium; its promoter drives BETL RNAi. Methods truncate the ID as Zm00001d04182.

BETL gene family member (NCBI betl10, defensin-like); DE c2 0.85 vs 0.09 (Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun) and BETL 10.6x in Visium (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun SD1). Two independent enrichments, no in situ read here, so medium.

Basal layer antifungal protein secreted into maternal tissue; in situ BETL (Serna et al. 2001 Plant J; Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun); DE c2 0.95 vs 0.13; BETL 12.9x in Visium (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun SD1).
Type-A response regulator specific to transfer cells, in situ (Muniz et al. 2006 Plant J); DE c2 0.45 vs 0.02 (Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun); BETL 8.7x in Visium (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun SD1).
Uncharacterized nsLTP; in situ BETL (Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun Supp Fig 6), DE c2/c9 but pct2 0.29; highest BETL gene in Visium, 9.3x (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun SD1).
Uncharacterized (NCBI LOC100286296); in situ BETL and reduced in mybr29 (Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun Fig 7f); BETL 12.3x in Visium (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun SD1).
Potassium transporter 10; BETL 4.6x in Visium only, low counts (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun Fig S13).

CLE-family ESR peptide; in situ ESR (Opsahl-Ferstad et al. 1997 Plant J); DE ESR c15 log2FC 8.0, 0.92 vs 0.02 (Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun); ESR 5.3x in Visium, some BETL (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun). Symbol conflict: NCBI aliases include ESR1, a separate locus (Zm00001d027820, no v5 xref).

Defensin with a protective role in the ESR, in situ (Balandin et al. 2005 Plant Mol Biol); DE c15 0.82 vs 0.005 (Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun). CONFLICT: in Visium BETL 7.6 vs ESR 13.6 (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun), so expect some BETL signal.
Uncharacterized; in situ ESR (Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun Supp Fig 6), DE c15 0.77 vs 0.01; ESR 5.5x in Visium (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun SD1). ID only in the papers' tables (not in NCBI Gene).
Hexose SWEET; in situ EAS (Doll et al. 2020 Plant Cell); EAS 11x in Visium (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun Fig S12). Sugar export toward the embryo fits EAS, but function not shown in the cell type.

SWEET; in situ EAS (Doll et al. 2020 Plant Cell; Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun Supp Fig 6, EAS progenitors); EAS 12x in Visium (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun). Not DE in Yuan SD4. Symbol from the papers; NCBI has no SWEET symbol (umc1791).
PEBP/FT-like; in situ EAS (Doll et al. 2020 Plant Cell); EAS 9.9x in Visium (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun SD1).
P-type Cu ATPase; in situ EAS (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun Fig 2k); EAS 5.6x in Visium. Single study.

Beta-1,3-galactosyltransferase (Male sterile8); in situ EAS progenitors (Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun Fig 1e); EAS 5.6x in Visium (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun SD1). CONFLICT: Yuan SD4 lists it as DE only in ESR c15.
Phosphate exporter PHO1-2; EAS 10.8x in Visium only (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun Fig S13).
Non-specific lipid-transfer protein 2 (UniProt P83506); in situ aleurone (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun Fig 2w); 4.4x over pericarp in Visium. Not DE in Yuan 2024 (6-7 DAP).

Aleurone-specific cDNA (5a2/AL-9, UniProt B4FFB8); aleurone highest in Visium but ESR nearly as high, 62 vs 44 (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun). CONFLICT: non-specific in Yuan et al. 2024 scRNA (pct 0.999 vs 0.931). v4 maps to two v5 models; Zm00001eb369440 carries B4FFB8.
nsLTP; authors' aleurone-vs-pericarp gate gene, 5.0x in Visium (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun); DE in Yuan 2024 AL clusters c0/c3 but weak (0.65-0.70 vs 0.38).
Sorbitol dehydrogenase; in situ CZ (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun Fig 2i) but only 1.6x over BETL and high in AL/VE; not specific in Yuan 2024 (0.96 vs 0.93). Use only as a basal-endosperm gradient gene.

Imprinted PLATZ TF required for storage-reserve accumulation, fl3 mutant (Li et al. 2017 Plant Cell); in situ SE and DE basal SE c8 0.82 vs 0.22 (Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun); highest in CZ/VE/SE in Visium (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun). Both datasets place it highest toward the basal endosperm. UniProt names the v5 model PLTZ2.

27-kD gamma-zein storage protein (UniProt P04706); endosperm-wide in Visium, VE 772 > SE 505 > AL 455 (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun); endosperm-contaminant DE in embryo scRNA (Wu et al. 2025 Nat Commun). High ambient risk in droplet data. v4 maps to Zm00001eb313810/313800; P04706 is 313800.

19-kD alpha-zein (z1A1 family; SD1 says zein-alpha PMS1, UniProt P24449); in situ peripheral endosperm (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun Fig 2e); VE 215 > AL 129 > SE 110. Paralogous zein genes: check multimapping.
Cytosolic ADP-glucose pyrophosphorylase small subunit, bt2 mutant shrunken endosperm; SE/VE >= 10 vs <= 2.1 elsewhere in Visium (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun). Endosperm-wide, not regional.
Sucrose synthase 1 (UniProt P04712), sh1 mutant shrunken endosperm; SE 68, VE 36, others <= 10 in Visium (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun).
Starch synthase III DULL1 (NCBI/SD1), du1 mutant; SE 2.8x in Visium, low counts. CORRECTION: Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun Fig S12 calls this ID SS2.
Opaque-2 bZIP activator of zein genes (UniProt P12959); endosperm-specific in Visium (SE/VE/AL 1.8-3.2 vs <= 1.1 elsewhere), not regional (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun). Also aleurone.
Phytosulfokine precursor; SE 3.4x in Visium, weak in situ (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun Fig 2g); not specific in Yuan 2024 (0.997 vs 0.962).

Oleosin 16 kDa (UniProt P13436, OLE16); in situ scutellum (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun Fig 2m); 2.2x over embryo axis. Oil-body protein of the whole embryo. ID corrected from review JSON (Zm00001eb074950 is not the oleosin model).

Globulin-1 embryo storage protein (UniProt P15590); scutellum 2.6x in Visium (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun); scutellum-parenchyma DE 0.84 vs 0.50 (Wu et al. 2025 Nat Commun). Two weak enrichments; rises with maturation.

nsLTP (plt3); in situ embryo axis (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun Fig 2o), 4.2x over pericarp; DE in the embryo-contaminant cluster of endosperm scRNA, 0.38 vs 0.05 (Yuan et al. 2024 Nat Commun). Not raised: Yuan's cluster is the whole embryo.
Benzoxazinoid O-methyltransferase; embryo axis 3.3x in Visium, low counts (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun).
Subtilisin-chymotrypsin inhibitor; embryo axis 6.3x in Visium (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun Fig S13). Paralog Zm00001d035681 is aleurone/VE: check multimapping.

ACC oxidase 20 (UniProt Q6JN54); in situ placento-chalazal region, noisy (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun Fig 2q); 11.4x over BETL in Visium. Region-level (pedicel parenchyma, vascular terminus, chalaza merged).
Cystatin 3 (UniProt Q4FZ53); weak in situ (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun Fig 2s); 5.2x in Visium.
MADS-box TF m1 (NCBI MADS1); placento-chalazal 4.0x in Visium only (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun Fig S13).
GT61 glycosyltransferase (uncharacterized); pericarp 3.5x over aleurone in Visium only (Fu et al. 2023 Nat Commun Fig S13). Pericarp layers not resolved.
